Mod.name: Mahoraga: Adapt to Anything
Mod.description: [h1]Mahoraga: Adapt to Anything[/h1] Mahoraga, the Eight-Handled Wheel, is waiting for you. Inspired by the shikigami from Jujutsu Kaisen, this mod adds a boss that adapts to whatever you throw at him: every kind of harm turns his wheel, makes him immune to it, makes him stronger and can teach him a new technique. He waits in a temple arena at the far east edge of every world (cross the desert eastwards). Beat him before he has adapted to everything you have. [h2]1.0 - The Wheel[/h2][list][*]A temple arena at the east edge of every world, with a tougher Mahoraga in each parallel world[*]He adapts to each kind of damage: once his wheel turns, it can no longer hurt him[*]Attacks: Sword of Extermination, Crushing Leap, Unstoppable Charge and Wheel Pulse[*]Reward: the Adapt to Anything perk, so you adapt to the harm you keep taking[/list] [h2]1.1 - New techniques[/h2][list][*]Every adaptation heals him and makes him stronger[*]He adapts to drowning too[*]His slashes cut through everything[*]Techniques his adaptations teach him: Giant Slash (melee), Giant Napalm (fire), Giant Nuke (explosions), Electrocute Giant Punch (electricity) and Holy Shower (holy)[/list] [h2]1.2 - Your own Mahoraga[/h2][list][*]Every adaptation makes him far tougher and deadlier[*]World Cutting Slash (slicing)[*]New perk Summon Mahoraga: call your own Mahoraga with a key of your choice; he shares your adaptations and their techniques[*]Adapt to Anything can now make you fully immune, and every new adaptation makes you stronger[*]A new animated sprite[/list] [h2]1.3 - Escape from Mahoraga[/h2][list][*]Escape mode: Mahoraga leaves his arena as your run begins and digs his way to you; beat him, then face him at full strength in his arena[*]Divine Dogs perk: the white dog, then both dogs, then Totality as they kill; they bite and dash at enemies to claw them[*]Omega Black Hole (curses) and Earthquake (impacts)[*]Energy shields (projectiles), swimming (drowning) and a far bigger Electrocute Giant Punch[/list] [h2]1.4 - Adapt to Anything, for real[/h2][list][*]He adapts to every curse (the sun, the cursed rock, black holes...) and to harmful materials such as lava and acid[*]He adapts to your defenses: when his attacks stop working he studies why and overcomes projectile repulsion and slowing fields, shields, protections and immunities, invisibility and evasion[*]New techniques: Magma Torrent (materials), Phantom Step (evasion) and Cursed Wheel (protections)[/list] [h2]How to play[/h2][list][*]Subscribe and turn the mod on in the Mods menu[*]Options > Mod settings: the Summon Mahoraga key (G), the Divine Dogs key (H) and the Escape from Mahoraga mode[*]Single player[/list] Fan-made, inspired by Jujutsu Kaisen by Gege Akutami; not affiliated with the series or with Nolla Games. All sprites were drawn for this mod.
